services.title: Advanced Dental Laser Treatments
services.description: High-precision soft-tissue laser treatments offering pain-free gum contouring, ulcer therapy, and frenectomies with minimal bleeding and swift recovery.
services.idealFor: Gum reshaping, mouth ulcers, sensitive roots, gummy smiles

services.title: Rotary Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
services.description: Advanced rotary root canal therapy using precision electronic apex locators to eliminate infection and relieve acute pain in a single visit.
services.idealFor: Severe toothache, deep decay, sensitive pulp

services.title: Aesthetic Zirconia & Ceramic Crowns
services.description: Premium monolithic zirconia crowns engineered for extreme durability, lifelike tooth shade translucency, and permanent chewing power.
keyBenefits: Matched to your natural tooth shade
services.idealFor: Post-root canal teeth, broken enamel, heavy bite forces

services.title: Surgical & Routine Tooth Extractions
services.description: Atraumatic extraction of non-restorable teeth or painful wisdom roots using micro-surgical elevators to minimize bone disturbance.
services.idealFor: Severely decayed teeth, painful wisdom molars

services.title: Ultrasonic Scaling & Enamel Polishing
services.description: Thorough ultrasonic scaling to remove stubborn yellow calculus and tobacco stains from gum margins, followed by gentle diamond polishing.
services.idealFor: Tartar buildup, swollen gums, smoker stains, routine cleaning

services.title: Composite Tooth-Colored Restorations
services.description: High-durability resin composite fillings bonded directly into cavities, restoring natural tooth structure with invisible aesthetic margins.
services.idealFor: Cavities, chipped front teeth, worn biting surfaces
